name: DYSTOPIA Sound Art Biennial 2024: Focus on India
description: Following previous editions focused on Turkey and Brazil, DYSTOPIA 24 centers on sound-related practices from the Indian subcontinent. The biennial invites sound art projects that resist dys/utopian topologies through acoustic, spatial, sculptural, and performative means. This edition challenges colonial formations and state hegemonies by listening to landscapes differently and composing alternative imaginaries of territory, addressing questions of extractive capitalism, climate catastrophe, and the depletion of struggle.
